scope: Only the supplied gemma-prompt-blind-w.json was read for these W judgments. Prior own blind judgments were used for comparison; no prompts, identities, metrics or other experiment data inspected.
limitations: Assistant linguistic judgment, not expert/native-speaker validation; corpus and checks are not human gold.
Same rubric as X/Y/Z: natural equivalents accepted; materially weakened explicit profanity, invented personal/gendered targets, significant referent/fact changes and untranslated key spans are major.

Serbian colloquial exclamations and severity need native-speaker confirmation. Jebo ga is accepted as a colloquial exclamation rather than penalized by exact-string matching. W033 has independently clear plural/singular defects as well as a questionable exclamation.
New_heldout counts as recovered_regression. Natural target quotation glyphs and equivalent clock notation are accepted; actual quotation meaning, code, URL, bold and newlines are checked.
Rating ties may conceal substantive gains or new errors; W041 corrects the train fact while retaining a major profanity-softening issue.

freshValidation.explanation: W correctly renders train before bus in 21, but weakens explicit joder to damn in 12. Same aggregate count therefore conceals a fact-versus-register tradeoff.

recoveredRegression.explanation: W translates the Greek-target English question in 0, though the address stress is wrong, and fixes train instead of bus with preserved profanity in 42. It changes the Greek addressed noun to bullshit in 1 and leaves fratello untranslated in 3/5/6.

sameRatingMaterialChanges: W041 fixes the Serbian Latin-source train-to-bus fact error but weakens explicit jebote to damn, so it remains major.
W033 replaces previous malformed/mixed-language Serbian with a different defective exclamation plus plural trains and singular verb; still major.
W023 restores the actually/after-all nuance while retaining the unnatural you fucking Floet address, so it remains minor.

overall.interpretation: W has two fewer major ratings and five more minor ratings, while fresh counts tie. This is a tradeoff, not dominance or evidence that every required behavior is fixed.

findings.strongestGain: Corrects the Serbian transport facts in fresh case 21 and recovered cases 41/42. Case 42 also preserves explicit profanity correctly.
findings.strongestNewFailuresVsY: Leaves fratello untranslated in three German-target cases, changes Greek addressed malaka to malakia in the queue case, and weakens explicit joder in fresh case 12.
findings.unresolvedRequiredBehavior: Invented personal/gendered targets persist in 51/52/56. Serbian Cyrillic output 33 remains defective. Strong expletives are still weakened in 12/38/41. Luca is still converted from an addressee into an identity assertion in 10. The Spanish request grammar defect in 28 remains.
findings.conclusion: W is a useful transport-fact improvement with fewer major judgments overall, but does not clearly dominate Y: fresh counts tie and several address/completeness/regional-script-language defects persist. None of W/X/Y/Z satisfies the complete required behavior set. No automatic adoption is supported by this assistant review.
